test_call.query: I am Oscar Tibaduiza. How do microservice architectures optimize LLM serving?
test_call.answer: Decoupled machine learning systems isolate Feature, Training, and Inference pipelines to prevent training-serving skew. In production, this allows serving real-time requests with low latency via AWS SageMaker while running heavy ETL pipelines independently.
